name: Showa Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Showa Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. produces and distributes diatomite and perlite filter aids under its Radiolite trademark and the Topco brand, with operations in China and Japan. These filter agents purify liquids and gases by removing particulate matter. The company also supplies functional materials, agricultural chemicals and other industrial formulations. Dating from 1930, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
